about: Quarterly series for the semiconductor / AI-capex deck. Every number was read from a file downloaded on 2026-11-09 (SEC XBRL companyfacts, SK hynix newsroom, Samsung newsroom, WSTS workbook, SIA releases); nothing is from memory or estimated.

units.bigtech: USD billion, 3 decimals (exact: the filings are in USD million). fcf = ocf - capex; finance-lease principal not deducted.
units.skhynix: KRW trillion, 4 decimals (exact: source tables are in 억 원 = KRW 0.1 billion). Consolidated, K-IFRS.
units.samsung: KRW trillion exactly as printed by Samsung Newsroom (two decimals through 2024Q2; one decimal from 2024Q3 except 2024Q3 operating profit 9.18 and 2025Q1 revenue 79.14). Consolidated.
units.wsts: USD billion, 6 decimals (exact: workbook is in thousand USD). Actual monthly billings summed by calendar quarter (not the 3-month moving average).

wsts.unit: USD billion = workbook value (unit '1000 US$', cell A3: 'All numbers are in 1000 US$.') / 1,000,000; 6 decimals are exact

wsts.source_page_statement: Four decades of WSTS statistics from the WSTS Blue Book are now available for free download - with latest data from August 2026.

unavailable.reason: September 2026 is blank in the August-2026 edition of the workbook (cells J246:J250 empty); no later edition is linked on the WSTS page as of 2026-11-09. Not estimated.

partial_2026Q3_jul_aug_only.warning: two months only (July + August); NOT a quarterly total

sia_reported_2026Q3.caveat: SIA press-release figure rounded to $0.1bn, WSTS data of the September-2026 vintage (one vintage later than the workbook). Derived by me: its +24.1% QoQ implies 2026Q2 = 417.16 (range 416.96-417.37 after rounding) at that vintage versus 416.289 in the August workbook, so 2026 months were revised again.

wsts_release_2026-08-06.sentence: The global semiconductor market reached 702 billion US dollars in the first half of 2026, representing a 102 percent increase year-over-year.

half_years.explanation: The 702 in the WSTS release of 2026-08-06 is the first-published vintage (SIA: Q1 298.5 + Q2 403.3 = 701.8). The August-2026 workbook holds revised 2026 months: Q1 305.712, Q2 416.289, H1 722.001. H1 2025 is 346.967 in the workbook (the project's 347.5 was back-computed as 702/2.02).

bigtech_method.fact_selection: for each exact (start, end) duration the most recently filed fact (largest filed date, then accession number)
bigtech_method.ocf_capex: YTD differencing inside the fiscal year: Q1 = 3M YTD fact; Q2 = 6M - 3M; Q3 = 9M - 6M; Q4 = FY - 9M
bigtech_method.revenue: fiscal Q1-Q3 = discrete 3-month fact as reported in the 10-Q; fiscal Q4 = FY - 9M YTD (no discrete Q4 fact exists)
bigtech_method.microsoft_calendar_mapping: fiscal year starts July 1: calendar Q3 = fiscal Q1 (3M YTD), calendar Q4 = fiscal Q2 (6M - 3M), calendar Q1 = fiscal Q3 (9M - 6M), calendar Q2 = fiscal Q4 (FY - 9M). Quarter ends are calendar month-ends.
bigtech_method.alphabet_revenue_tag: RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax in filings up to the 10-Q filed 2025-04-25; Revenues from the 10-Q filed 2025-07-24 on. Both tags are pooled and the latest filed fact per period is used (the tag actually used is recorded per quarter in bigtech_provenance).

sia_cross_check.title: Global Semiconductor Sales Increase 25% from Q4 2025 to Q1 2026
sia_cross_check.sentence: WASHINGTON—May 4, 2026—The Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA) today announced global semiconductor sales were $298.5 billion during the first quarter of 2026, an increase of 25% compared to Q4 of 2025. Global sales were $99.5 billion during the month of March 2026, an increase of 79.2% compared to the March 2025 total of $55.5 billion and 11.5% more than sales in February 2026.

sia_cross_check.title: Global Semiconductor Sales Increase 9.2% Month-to-Month in May
sia_cross_check.sentence: WASHINGTON, July 6, 2026—The Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA) today announced global semiconductor sales were $120.6 billion during the month of May 2026, an increase of 9.2% compared to the April 2026 total of $110.5 billion and 104.1% more than the May 2025 total of $59.1 billion.

sia_cross_check.title: Global Semiconductor Sales Increase 35.1% from Q1 2026 to Q2 2026
sia_cross_check.sentence: WASHINGTON, August 6, 2026—The Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA) today announced global semiconductor sales were $403.3 billion during the second quarter of 2026, an increase of 35.1% compared to Q1 of 2026. Global sales were $134.5 billion during the month of June 2026, an increase of 123.6% compared to June 2025 and 9.7% more than sales in May 2026.

sia_cross_check.title: Global Semiconductor Sales Increase 6.4% Month-to-Month in July
sia_cross_check.sentence: WASHINGTON, Sept. 4, 2026 – The Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA) today announced global semiconductor sales were $146.8 billion during the month of July 2026, an increase of 6.4% compared to the June 2026 total of $137.9 billion and 135.1% more than the July 2025 total of $62.5 billion.

sia_cross_check.title: Year-to-Date Global Semiconductor Sales Top $1 Trillion Through August
sia_cross_check.sentence: WASHINGTON, Oct. 5, 2026 – The Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA) today announced global semiconductor sales were $159.7 billion during the month of August 2026, an increase of 8% compared to the July 2026 total of $147.9 billion and 144.3% more than the August 2025 total of $65.4 billion.

sia_cross_check.title: Global Semiconductor Sales Increase 24.1% from Q2 2026 to Q3 2026
sia_cross_check.sentence: WASHINGTON, Nov. 3, 2026 – The Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA) today announced global semiconductor sales were $517.7 billion during the third quarter of 2026, an increase of 24.1% compared to the second quarter of 2026. Global sales were $172.6 billion during the month of September 2026, an increase of 146.8% compared to September 2025 and 7.9% more than sales in August 2026.

sources.skhynix_newsroom_kr: https://news.skhynix.co.kr/ (per-quarter URLs in skhynix[].url_kr; tables in 억 원)

notes: Big tech revenue: 5 quarters where the reported 3-month fact differs by USD 1 million from the YTD difference (rounding in the filings); the reported 3-month value is used. As a result the four quarters of Alphabet 2025 and Meta 2023/2024/2025 sum to the annual fact +/- USD 0.001bn.

Meta capex 2023 (and FY2022) was re-presented from the 2024 filings on: PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment became net of proceeds from sales of property. Latest-filed values are used, so 2023 quarters are on the same (net) basis as later years; they differ from the originally filed 2023 figures.
WSTS data are revised with every monthly edition; all WSTS numbers here are the August-2026 edition of the workbook. First half 2026 = 722.001165 in this edition, not 702.
WSTS 2026Q3 is not available from the workbook (September missing). SIA's rounded $517.7bn is given separately and is from a later data vintage.
Samsung figures are as announced in each quarter's newsroom post (rounded by Samsung); sums of rounded quarters differ from the announced annual totals by up to 0.1.
SK hynix operating profit: sums of quarters differ from the announced annual figure by 1억 (0.0001 trillion) in 2023 and 2025 because of rounding in the releases.
